facts.text: The repository controls an Ando AQ-6315A Optical Spectrum Analyzer.
The Ando class opens a pyvisa GPIB resource for the OSA.
set_current_trace writes ACTV0 for A, ACTV1 for B and ACTV2 for C.
get_sweep_status maps reply 0 to STOP, 1 to SINGLE, 2 and 3 to AUTO and 4 to SEGMENT_MEASURE.
set_sweep_status writes STP for STOP, SGL for SINGLE, RPT for AUTO and MEAS for SEGMENT_MEASURE.
set_start_wl and set_stop_wl send the value with the STAWL and STPWL commands and append '.00'.
set_center_wl and set_span send the CTRWL and SPAN commands.
The GUI labels the wavelength axis and the start, stop, center and span values in nm.
The trace plot labels power in dBm for LOG scale and mW for LIN scale.
get_trace returns the intensity and wavelength arrays for traces A, B and C.
The GUI changes the measurement state through set_sweep_status.
